verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Recurly only in the MCP server role: Compass MCP exposes Recurly docs and APIs to external agents like Claude Desktop or Cursor. Nothing shows Recurly acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
